Evidence/CLM-025
Evidence record

Geographic coverage limits of the latest Findex wave

What does this evidence establish?

The latest Yemen Findex wave excludes Al Baydaa, Al Jawf, Mareb, Sadah, Socotra and several districts elsewhere; the source states excluded areas represent approximately 23% of the population, and over one-fourth of primary sampling units were replaced during fieldwork.

What does it measure?

A documented limitation on the geographic coverage of the latest Yemen Findex observation.

Who or what does it apply to?

The population of Yemen and the survey frame of the Findex 2021 study

When was it measured or observed?

2021 Findex wave; Yemen fieldwork 2022-11-07 to 2023-01-09

How current is it?

These coverage limits apply to the 2021 Findex wave, with Yemen fieldwork from 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023, the latest wave available for Yemen. They describe that survey only, not any later one.

What this evidence does not establish

The wave does not cover all of Yemen, and its results cannot be used to map financial inclusion by governorate.

Limits of the measure

The survey frame excludes areas holding about 23% of the population, and more than a quarter of primary sampling units were replaced.
